campaigns.description: Phosphorylated CTD-interacting factor 1 (a.k.a. CAPAM); RNA pol II C-terminal domain binder; m6A methyltransferase for RNA Pol II CTD transcription start site mRNAs
campaigns.rationale: truly_novel (0 SMA papers), druggable bucket=4 (Structure with Ligand exists). Near TP53 axis (cos_TP53=0.826) and PERP (cos_PERP=0.786). Transcription / m6A modification is a plausible SMN-downstream axis (SMN's role in snRNP assembly + splicing regulation).
campaigns.pocketxmol_plan: 600 molecules guided by PCIF1 SAM-binding pocket (co-crystal PDB 7VS2 as seed)

campaigns.description: Bromodomain PHD finger transcription factor; largest subunit of NURF chromatin remodeler; reads H3K4me3 + acetyl-lysine
campaigns.rationale: truly_novel (0 SMA papers), druggable bucket=4. PHD/bromodomain readers are targetable (see BET inhibitors). Chromatin mis-regulation is a plausible SMA mechanism via Cajal body disruption and snRNP biogenesis failure.
campaigns.pocketxmol_plan: 600 molecules guided by BPTF bromodomain acetyl-lysine pocket (PDB 3UV2)

campaigns.description: La ribonucleoprotein 1; translational regulator of terminal oligopyrimidine (TOP) mRNAs downstream of mTORC1
campaigns.rationale: truly_novel (0 SMA papers), druggable bucket=4. mTOR axis + translation regulation is plausibly disrupted in SMA (SMN regulates local translation at axon terminals). Near TP53 (cos_TP53=0.787) and PERP (cos_PERP=0.788).
campaigns.pocketxmol_plan: 600 molecules guided by LARP1 La-module cap-binding pocket (PDB 5V87)

campaigns.description: SH3 domain binding protein 5 (SAB); mitochondrial outer membrane JNK scaffolder; GEF for Rab11

campaigns.pocketxmol_plan: 600 molecules guided by SH3BP5 JNK-binding face (NMR structure 1OEB)
